appName.message: Study Buddy — AI Powered Study Assistant

shortDesc.message: Meet Study Buddy, your AI homework helper and AI tutor. Select any screen area to ask AI, get math help, and ace quiz.

storeDesc.message:
📚 Meet Study Buddy, the AI helper and ai tutor that lives right inside Chrome. Select any part of your screen and Ask AI anything: get homework help and step-by-step explanations without retyping a word.

This extension works on text, images, equations, and diagrams. It's an AI powered study assistant, an ai math solver, and a study helper in one click.

🤯 Studying shouldn't feel this hard

- Equations that refuse to copy
- Scanned worksheets that are just pictures
- Answers with zero explanation
- Five apps open to finish one task
- Tutors that cost a fortune per hour

✨ How Study Buddy fixes it

Just select what's confusing and get a clear explanation right next to it, on the same page.

🚀 How it works

1️⃣ Open any lesson, worksheet, or website in Chrome.
2️⃣ Select the question, image, or equation you're stuck on.
3️⃣ Pick an action, or open the chat right there.
4️⃣ Ask AI follow-ups until it finally makes sense.

🎯 Six tools in your AI homework helper and AI powered study assistant

➤ Solve: a full step-by-step walkthrough.
➤ Hint: a nudge that keeps the answer hidden.
➤ Check: spot mistakes before you submit.
➤ Explain: turn dense textbook language into plain English.
➤ Translate: decode foreign words and whole passages.
➤ Summarize: shrink a long article into key ideas.

🎓 A homework helper that teaches

Study Buddy is a buddy that explains instead of just handing over answers. It shows you how to get there yourself, powered by frontier AI models.

💡 Want ai powered homework help one step at a time? Start with Hint.
💡 Need a homework helper ai that grades your attempt? Tap Check.
💡 Prefer an AI powered homework helper that explains the "why"? Tap Explain.

That's Study Buddy: Homework AI built for learning. You still get hw answers, but now you understand them.

🧮 Math help without retyping symbols

▸ Algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics
▸ Word problems with diagrams and charts
▸ Fractions, graphs, and tricky proofs

Select the equation and let Study Buddy Math AI read it. The homework solver breaks down every step and shows where your logic went off track. Real math help, right beside the exercise: a math solver that teaches instead of just answering. Algebra, geometry or calculus — the same math AI handles them all.

📝 Ace every quiz

Practicing on Quizzez, Google Forms, or a school portal? Select a question and tap Explain: your quiz prep buddy walks you through the reasoning.

Hunting for HW answers? Ask why the wrong options are wrong. Use AI powered homework help as a warm-up, then try it solo.

💬 AI chat with context

Unlike a generic chat ai, every conversation starts with your screenshot, so replies are sharper.

• Ask the AI chat anything about your selection.
• Request a simpler explanation from your AI tutor or a new example.
• Get homework help and a quick recap before an exam.
• Double-check any answer AI gives you.

With Study Buddy, every question AI helps you crack is a small win for your study session.

📌 Always close at hand

📍 Minimize the popup to a tiny bubble and reopen it in one click.
📍 Close the window anytime: your chat history stays saved.

The assistant blends into your study routine instead of taking it over, keeping you focused on the study material.

⭐ Why students love Study Buddy

⚡ Fast: help appears in seconds, right on the page.
🧠 Smart: unlike a typical answer AI, it shows real reasoning, not just a final number.
🎒 Flexible: school, college, exam prep, or self-study.

🔍 Reads text inside images

Built-in text recognition lets this AI helper read words in photos, scans, and screenshots, even when copying is impossible.

🌍 More than homework

- Languages: translate sentences and idioms
- Reading: summarize long pages in seconds
- Research: explore charts and visuals
- Curiosity: learn more about any topic
- Exams: review key concepts with your AI Tutor, a buddy for late-night review

❓ FAQ

💬 Can Study Buddy read images?
👉 Yes. Diagrams, graphs, screenshots, and scans all work.

💬 Is it only a homework helper?
👉 No. It translates, summarizes, and explains anything you read online.

💬 What artificial intelligence powers it?
👉 Modern artificial intelligence that reasons step by step and adapts to your follow-ups.

💬 Will my chats disappear?
👉 Never. Your chat history stays saved after you close the popup.

💬 Does this homework AI help with tests?
👉 Yes. Use Hint, Check, and Explain to review tricky questions before exam day.

🏁 Ready to study smarter?

Add Study Buddy to Chrome today. Select what's blocking you and let your new Study Helper and homework buddy turn stress into progress.
